statement: A VAT registration obligation arises when a person's calendar-year supply with an Estonian place of supply exceeds 40,000 euros counted from the beginning of the calendar year, and the registration application must reach the tax authority within three working days of the obligation arising; it can be filed in e-MTA or, digitally signed, through the commercial register's information system (Value-Added Tax Act §§ 19(1), 20(1)).
caveat: Voluntary registration below the threshold is open under § 20(2). The standard VAT rate is 24% from 2025-07-01 (§ 15(1)). Supply that is wholly tax-free or zero-rated (other than intra-Community supply of goods) does not trigger the obligation, and separate EU regimes (the union OSS, the small-business scheme for other member states) ride their own rules.
